body:

Reason: Rudeness/Spam

replies.body: Still awaiting a response. I know that you guys have lives outside of minecraft but it is difficult to watch so many staff members online and still not have an update/response.

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

Sorry for the late response.

Unfortunately i have decided to deny your appeal due to the fact that it's valid.

You were in fact being rude to other members and talking is full caps.(Spam)

You may think that this punishment was somewhat harsh but looking at your past infractions i can see why it was a Temp-ban. You're lucky that it's not a Perm-Ban.

Regards,
LegendaryEngram, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
